import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Positive-valued dataset for Box-Cox transformation
np.random.seed(42)
data = {
    'revenue': np.random.gamma(shape=2, scale=1000, size=50),
    'users': np.random.gamma(shape=3, scale=100, size=50),
    'sessions': np.random.gamma(shape=1.5, scale=50, size=50)
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Check that all values are positive (required for Box-Cox)
print("All values positive:", (df > 0).all().all())

# Apply Box-Cox transformation to each column and capture lambda
transformed_data = {}
lambda_values = {}
for col in df.columns:
    transformed, lam = stats.boxcox(df[col])
    transformed_data[col] = transformed
    lambda_values[col] = lam

df_boxcox = pd.DataFrame(transformed_data)

# Compare skewness before and after transformation
print("\nSkewness BEFORE Box-Cox:")
for col in df.columns:
    print(f"  {col}: {stats.skew(df[col]):.3f}")

print("\nSkewness AFTER Box-Cox:")
for col in df_boxcox.columns:
    print(f"  {col}: {stats.skew(df_boxcox[col]):.3f}")

# Print the transformed data and lambda values
print("\nOptimal lambda values:")
for col, lam in lambda_values.items():
    print(f"  {col}: {lam:.4f}")
print("\nTransformed data (first 5 rows):")
print(df_boxcox.head())
